notes.subject: wakwa / yayo
notes.rationale: Gĩkũyũ ihiũra kiugo kĩa gĩcunjĩ kĩa עמל na gĩcunjĩ kĩa תזכר; ⟨yayo⟩ nĩyongeretwo kũonainia kĩndũ gĩa kũikũrwo

notes.subject: ta mai arĩa magĩthũrire
notes.rationale: Kĩhibirania kĩuganaga 'ta mai goigũa' — maũndũ merĩkĩtie ti makĩgooka; Gĩkũyũ nĩũgĩte o ũguo na 'mai marĩa magĩthũrire'

notes.subject: nĩwĩ
notes.rationale: אתה nĩ mũgambo wa kũgeria ngombo; 'nĩwĩ' no ũtuĩke ũgĩcoketwo thutha wa תשכח ta 'wĩĩrage', no thutha wa כי ndĩagĩrĩirwo

translation: Nĩgũkorwo nĩũkairega hinya-wa-maũndũ wakwa, nĩũkaikũra ⟨yayo⟩ ta mai arĩa magĩthũrire.
